say: Confirming the lens. Materials per part - wood, seat, floor, walls, lamp - and the palette as a whole: family, warmth, lightness.
Rendering the anchor room. Every variation will be drawn from this one picture, so the layout cannot wander.
One dimension only: material and palette together. Same room, same furniture shapes, same light - Muse proposes what else it could be made of.
Writing down what held still, so the variations can be compared like for like.
Laying out the sheet: the anchor, the three versions side by side, and the note on what held still.
